text.p: These are the leading stories in the Turkish press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- An Islamist plan to infiltrate military academies is revealed in a private channel television programme.
- Members of a far-right Islamist organisation pull down a statue of Ataturk, the Turkish republic's founder, in Istanbul.

- The opposition and the conservative coalition partner call for an inquiry into a verbal attack on Ataturk by an Islamist mayor in the town of Kayseri during a ceremony commemorating the anniversary of Ataturk's death.
- One million Turks visit Ataturk's mausoleum on Sunday and Monday.
- Eighteen out of 102 prisoners on hunger strike at a prison in the western town of Aydin are in critical condition.
- Libya has not paid its $160 million debt to Turkish contractors promised during the Turkish prime minister's visit to the north African country.
- A 50,000 Turkish lira coin enters circulation.
